text: She works the bellows from first light and feels the shame of the work most; she says so (record notes).
Disputes the tally the stall writes for every lot his family brings in.
She takes her quarrels to the poler and will not deal with the Legion's heirs at the well.
Holds the spring's ladle at the stone lip and will not grant that the spring is souring. She is wrong; the minder and the jar-filler taste the salt.
Spends his share on the jaw beetle fights at Archon, not the Compact's dues (record lines).
No guild: mends for whoever brings a net; pays no share (record life block).
He smokes the hides and keeps the best for trade; he is the camp's seller.
She holds the bend by day and knaps flint there; from it she has found walkers Cut-Rope killed on the same tracks. The camp gets the blame. She is right to worry.
She walks the doors for the house and believes the channel work ends each debt in time.
She brings the day's net up from the deep lot herself (record notes) and knows what the deep lot costs.
Poles the raft through the toll every crossing; the toll comes out of the crew's share.
Writes each boat in two columns and knows the levy funds a quarrel as much as the state.
He wraps and carries bodies the Rose would not let go without coin; he sees the families at their worst (record notes).
Scrubs the teeth down to the waterline each day and never past it; below the line is where the temple's dangers live.
A pardon without the back pay in the pay book is worth nothing to him; he parleys for the book (record questHooks.opportunity).
The tree marks every adult on the roll and shows the strain; she reads that strain.
The gang families downriver were hatched under this Hist and still claim it; she sells to their camp and resents every word of the claim.
